description: Agglomerations (Urban Waste Water Treatment Directive) is a dataset listed in Geonorge, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Miljødataseksjonen. Datasettet tettbebyggelser er laget av SSB på oppdrag fra Miljødirektoratet, og oppdateres ved behov. Hensikten er å vise hvilken tettbebyggelse de ulike renseanlegg per i dag hører til, slik at vi bl.a. kan fastlegge hvem som er forurensningsmyndighet. Kartene inkluderer foreløpig ikke fritidsboliger. Coverage: Miljødataseksjonen. The publisher named on the listing is Miljødataseksjonen. Its keywords include Tettbebyggelser. The listing shows 2018-09-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geonorge.
